gate_title: OPS-02 Dataset Freeze and Future Training Authorization Gate

1_is_ops02_frozen.evidence: OPS02_v1.0.0_FROZEN established in data/ops02/OPS02_DATASET_FREEZE_SPEC_v1.json with cryptographic hashes and explicit sample counts.

2_are_all_selected_samples_physically_pr.evidence: All 212 GeoTIFF imagery files and 212 PNG mask files physically verified on disk with 0 missing files.

3_is_provenance_complete.evidence: Every sample resolves to exact Level-1 GRD parent scene, mission datatake ID, satellite, orbit, timestamp, and SHA-256 hash.

4_is_geometry_verified.evidence: Relative pixel grid alignment is strongly supported (2560x2560 Level-1 crop downsampled by 10x10 block-mean matching 256x256 label grid). Absolute geocoding in GeoTIFF headers is an engineering placeholder transform.

5_is_semantic_label_evidence_adequate.evidence: Semantic masks are authoritative Tier-A manual expert annotations from Li et al. (2020). Encoding integrity is 100% verified across all 212 masks.

6_is_independence_verified.evidence: Along-track scenes clustered by mission datatake ID into 64 disjunct parent clusters. 0 overlap with OPS-01 parents.

7_is_partition_leakage_absent.evidence: 0 parent clusters, 0 datatakes, 0 scenes, and 0 products span multiple partitions across TRAIN, DEV, and HOLDOUT.

8_is_holdout_pristine.evidence: HOLDOUT partition (12 clusters, 39 samples) has experienced zero model loading, zero inference, zero threshold calibration, and zero training use.

9_is_taxonomy_frozen.evidence: Canonical 12-class dense taxonomy [0..11] frozen in data/ops02/audits/ops02_taxonomy_freeze_v1.json. Class 14 (Mineral Oil Spill) strictly quarantined.

10_are_source_licensing_issues_acceptabl.evidence: Li et al. (Zenodo 14279466) is licensed under CC-BY 4.0; Sentinel-1 imagery is governed by Copernicus Open Access terms. Redistribution of derived research patches with attribution is permitted.

11_is_reproducibility_sufficiently_speci.evidence: Documented in data/ops02/audits/ops02_reproducibility_audit_v1.json with explicit crop bounds, strides, offsets, and aggregation formulas.

12_are_class_limitations_explicitly_unde.evidence: HM has 14 parent clusters but only 1,847 pixels (minimally usable; inadequate for strong generalization). OF has only 7 parent clusters (4 TRAIN, 1 DEV, 2 HOLDOUT; scientifically weak).

14_is_the_gpu_execution_strategy_defined.evidence: Kaggle GPU designated as default training execution platform to preserve host hardware; runtime accelerator selection and profiling specified.

15_are_there_any_blocking_issues.evidence: Zero fatal technical, provenance, or leakage blockers remain. The dataset is ready for authorized training under documented limitations.

explicit_scientific_limitations: OPS-02 remains single-archive grounded in the Li IW dataset; it expands physical acquisitions from 27 to 91 datatakes, but is not an external multi-source benchmark.
HM representation is pixel-sparse (1,847 pixels, mean 97 px/sample); models must not claim robust vessel detection generalization.
OF representation has only 4 TRAIN and 1 DEV parent cluster; boundary validation is sensitive to single-scene variance.
GeoTIFF affine headers use an engineering coordinate frame; precision geospatial GIS overlay requires native Sentinel-1 GCP geocoding.
authorized_next_actions: EXP-07-P0-C16 may be authorized to execute the first training run on frozen OPS-02 (Seed 42) using Kaggle GPU environment.
prohibited_actions: No evaluation on HOLDOUT during model selection.
